feature_comment: Implementation plan ready for the Dynamics 365 skillset rollout. The work is split into package scaffolding, authoring the Dynamics-specific skill content, and updating repository documentation so the new bundle installs and appears alongside the existing backend and webapp skillsets.

tasks.title: Scaffold the Dynamics skill package
tasks.body:
## Summary
Create the new `autoplan-dynamics-skills/` package so it matches the installable structure already used by the backend and webapp bundles.

## Scope
- Add `autoplan-dynamics-skills/README.md`.
- Add `autoplan-dynamics-skills/scripts/Install-Skills.ps1` and `autoplan-dynamics-skills/scripts/Uninstall-Skills.ps1`.
- Create the initial `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` + `references/` folder layout for the Dynamics bundle.
- Keep script behavior aligned with the existing target and auto symlink/copy conventions.

## Done when
- The package layout satisfies AC-1 from `docs/54-add-dynamics-skillset/design.md`.
- The installer and uninstaller expose the same user-facing workflow as the existing skill packages.

tasks.title: Author Dynamics architecture and Dataverse modeling skills
tasks.body:
## Summary
Add the first Dynamics guidance package content covering solution boundaries and Dataverse design decisions.

## Scope
- Write actionable `SKILL.md` guidance for Dynamics solution architecture and bounded-context decisions.
- Add Dataverse-focused guidance for tables, relationships, ownership, lifecycle, and performance.
- Place deeper supporting material in `references/` so the top-level skill instructions stay concise.
- Ground the content in Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse developer documentation called out by the design.

## Done when
- The new skill content clearly distinguishes Dynamics platform concerns from generic backend integration work.
- At least one substantive Dynamics skill exists with task-facing instructions plus deeper references, satisfying AC-2 and AC-4.

tasks.title: Author Dynamics extensibility, integration, and release skills
tasks.body:
## Summary
Complete the initial Dynamics bundle with guidance for server-side execution, external integrations, and delivery quality.

## Scope
- Add skills or reference content for plugins, custom workflow/actions, execution pipeline behavior, telemetry, and failure handling.
- Add guidance for Dynamics Web API usage, authentication expectations, and integration patterns with external systems.
- Add testing, ALM, and deployment-check guidance for Dynamics-focused delivery work.
- Keep the content consistent with the portable skill pattern already used in this repository.

## Done when
- The initial skill set from section 3.2 of the design is covered across the Dynamics package.
- The package gives teams actionable guidance for build, test, and release decisions in Dynamics projects.

tasks.title: Document and verify the Dynamics skillset rollout
tasks.body:
## Summary
Update repository-level documentation so Dynamics is discoverable as an official Autoplan option and verify the package behaves like the existing bundles.

## Scope
- Update `README.md` and `DOCUMENTATION.md` to include the Dynamics skillset in the layered model, install flow, and skillset-selection guidance.
- Add Dynamics-specific setup examples for Dynamics-only and mixed integration scenarios.
- Verify the new install/uninstall scripts against the expected target-path and symlink/copy behavior in a sandbox or dry-run flow.
- Confirm no generated cache artifacts are committed as part of the change.

## Done when
- Documentation satisfies AC-3 from the design.
- Validation shows the new package can be installed and removed consistently with the existing skill packages.
